name: @mercatus-liber/adapter-convex
description: A real fourth reference persistence adapter (adapter-convex epic), backed by Convex -- implements @mercatus-liber/core's CatalogPersistenceAdapter interface against a real-time, TypeScript-native reactive backend, the furthest storage paradigm from adapter-sqlite/adapter-postgres/adapter-mongodb named in this project's own roadmap. Structurally different from this repo's other adapters: Convex requires real server-side query/mutation functions deployed to YOUR OWN Convex project (there is no generic 'run arbitrary queries against any deployment' client) -- this package ships that real function source in convex-functions/ (copy into your project, `npx convex dev`/`deploy`) plus a client (createConvexAdapter/connectConvexAdapter) that calls those functions by name via Convex's own real, documented makeFunctionReference mechanism (no codegen needed on this repo's side). No live Convex account exists in this environment -- built and unit-tested for real correctness against a structurally-typed fake client double (same honest-disclosure posture as adapter-shippo/adapter-printful/adapter-printify/adapter-mongodb before their first live credential).
